headline: Australia's rooftop solar surge: nearly 14% of power now comes from the sun
meta_description: Rooftop solar now supplies nearly 14% of Australia's electricity, installed at around 4 million homes and small businesses.
summary_short: Rooftop solar in Australia has skyrocketed from less than 3% to nearly 14% of the nation's electricity supply in a decade.
body:
Rooftop solar now supplies nearly 14% of Australia's electricity—a remarkable leap from less than 3% a decade ago. This energy transformation has been built not by massive solar farms alone, but by everyday Australians taking matters into their own hands.

Around 4 million homes and small businesses across the country have installed solar systems on their rooftops, turning residential and commercial buildings into power generators. This distributed approach to renewable energy represents a fundamental shift in how Australians think about their electricity supply.

The scale of this transition reflects both the falling cost of solar technology and growing public commitment to clean energy. What began as a niche choice has become mainstream, quietly reshaping the nation's power grid one rooftop at a time.
quick_facts: Nearly 14% of Australia's electricity now from rooftop solar
Up from less than 3% a decade ago
Around 4 million homes and small businesses installed systems
Growth driven by residential and commercial adoption
